ordered_sections: 低傷害訓練器：槍不是每次都用得上
公開服務單：不是睡一覺就沒事

source_decisions: Professional protagonist tests shop equipment; six real player actions taught in order.
Training never invokes true death, first-clinic, fees, memory loss or checkpoint registration.
27400 historical paper savings and 480000 price do not become spendable credits.
Borrowed equipment restored on owner disposal, exit or whole skip; pause only suspends training.
Complete and whole-skip reach actual first-chapter dinner without completing dinner or briefing.
Whole skip does not mark unperformed actions successful; replay cannot mutate the live run.
Old saves already beyond prologue retain current progress; unknown save handling preserves evidence.
Late-chapter anchor identities, rain mechanism and backup transaction are not prematurely revealed.
Movie skip and whole-prologue skip are distinct; menus allow digital single-press alternatives.
Door-latch promise is completed at P06; firearm safe-line and mat recovery staging are explicit.
revision_checks: P04 dash-to-melee avoids firing an already-returned training gun; P06 only clears work tape and papers.
P05 has actual-down, no-failure and unpracticed variants instead of inventing a fall.
Saving borrowed equipment requires a formal-loadout projection before disk write, not only cleanup after owner exit.
runtime_handoffs: Safe training interception before real death and all fee/first-clinic hooks.
Actual action success and next safe step saved together; unperformed actions remain unpracticed.
Borrowed-loadout projection verified on autosave, quit, menu and cross-process continue.
Local movie skip, whole skip and isolated replay verified separately.
Actual prologue exit to dinner, with roof opening only after dinner completion.

references.adopted: Fixed links, room purpose and pacing contrast; no industry timing claim.
Remapped prompts, digital menus and alternatives to prolonged hold/rapid input.
